_readme: branch-protection.json is PUT verbatim to the GitHub branch-protection API by
scripts/apply-branch-protection.ps1, so it must contain only API fields.
Anything the repository needs to know about a required context lives here.
api_published_contexts declares required contexts that are NOT produced by a
workflow job display name. A pull_request_target job's automatic check run
attaches to the default-branch commit, not the pull request head, so it can
never satisfy a required status check. Those gates instead create a check run
explicitly against the pull request head SHA.
scripts/verify-required-checks.mjs resolves these declarations instead of
searching for a matching job name, and fails loudly if the workflow, the
publisher, or the policy's declared check name drifts.
